strategy: control — The Cruelty of Gix reanimator
identity: A mono-black attrition control deck. Seventeen Swamps mean zero fixing cost, zero tapped lands, zero life paid for mana and a 0.0pp colour gap in the audit, so every {B}{B} cost is castable the turn it comes up - which is what lets the deck run eight removal spells alongside a real engine. It trades one-for-one on curve while Braids Arisen Nightmare, Braids's Frightful Return, Gibbering Barricade and Bone Splinters convert its own spent bodies into cards and graveyard fuel. The graveyard then pays out three ways: Sheoldred's Restoration returns the best body, Braids's Frightful Return chapter II retrieves one to hand, and The Cruelty of Gix chapter III reads ANY graveyard - so the removal suite that answers the opponent's threats is simultaneously stocking the yard Cruelty steals from. Cult Conscript returns itself for {1}{B} off the same deaths. The clock is Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Tyrannical Pitlord; Blight Pile x2 is a SUPPLEMENTARY drain, not the win condition - '{2}{B}, {T}: Each opponent loses X life, where X is the number of creatures with defender you control' is loss rather than damage and so is blocker-proof and unpreventable, but simulated on this list X averages 1.0 at turn 5 and 1.4 by turn 8, not the 4 that a full board of Defenders would give.

{4}{B}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Return another target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

mainboard.name: Sheoldred's Restoration
mainboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {2}{W} (You may pay an additional {2}{W} as you cast this spell.)
Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If this spell was kicked, you gain life equal to that card's mana value. Otherwise, you lose that much life.
Exile Sheoldred's Restoration.

mainboard.name: Braids's Frightful Return
mainboard.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — You may sacrifice a creature. If you do, each opponent discards a card.
II — Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
III — Target opponent may sacrifice a nonland, nontoken permanent of their choice. If they don't, they lose 2 life and you draw a card.

mainboard.name: Braids, Arisen Nightmare
mainboard.oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, you may sacrifice an artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker. If you do, each opponent may sacrifice a permanent of their choice that shares a card type with it. For each opponent who doesn't, that player loses 2 life and you draw a card.

mainboard.name: The Cruelty of Gix
mainboard.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a creature or planeswalker card from it. That player discards that card.
II — Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle. You lose 3 life.
III — Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.

mainboard.name: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse
mainboard.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
Whenever you draw a card, you gain 2 life.
Whenever an opponent draws a card, they lose 2 life.

mainboard.name: Tyrannical Pitlord
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying, trample
As this creature enters, choose another creature you control.
The chosen creature gets +3/+3 and has flying.
When this creature leaves the battlefield, sacrifice the chosen creature.

sideboard.name: Karn's Sylex
sideboard.oracle_text:
Karn's Sylex enters tapped.
Players can't pay life to cast spells or to activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.
{X}, {T}, Exile Karn's Sylex: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value X or less. Activate only as a sorcery.
sideboard.when_to_board: The ONLY card a mono-black deck in this cube can cast that answers an artifact or an enchantment: '{X}, {T}, Exile Karn's Sylex: Destroy each nonland permanent with mana value X or less.' Board in against the 15 artifacts and 18 enchantments; at X=3 it clears most of them while Sheoldred (MV 4) and Tyrannical Pitlord (MV 6) survive.

sideboard.name: Knight of Dusk's Shadow
sideboard.oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Your opponents can't gain life.
{1}{B}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against the cube's 22 lifegain cards. 'Your opponents can't gain life' blanks Mossbeard Ancient's ETB, Silverback Elder's third mode and Prayer of Binding, on a 2/2 menace body with a pump ability so it is never a dead card.

sideboard.name: Battlefly Swarm
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flying
{B}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against the cube's largest threat class - 51 evasion cards, 20.6% density. A one-mana 1/1 flier whose '{B}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn' lets it block and kill a flier of ANY size; it is also an unconditional turn-1 play, which this deck otherwise has only two of.

sideboard.name: Tribute to Urborg
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{U} (You may pay an additional {1}{U} as you cast this spell.)
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets an additional -1/-1 until end of turn for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against fast starts. 'Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn' at instant speed for two mana, cast with the {1}{U} kicker declined - the scaling half of the card is off-colour, which is why it is a sideboard card and not a maindeck one.

sideboard.name: Splatter Goblin
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature dies, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against go-wide token decks (Tokens is the cube's 2nd-largest cluster at 38 cards). 'When this creature dies, target creature an opponent controls gets -1/-1 until end of turn' - a body that kills an x/1 on its way to the graveyard, where it then counts as a creature card for Sheoldred's Restoration.

sideboard.name: Phyrexian Rager
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against grindy decks - sacrifice fodder that replaces itself. 'When this creature enters, you draw a card and you lose 1 life', and it reaches the graveyard as a creature card for the reanimation package.

strategy_es: control — reanimador con The Cruelty of Gix
identity_es: Un control de desgaste mono negro. Diecisiete Swamps significan cero coste de fijado, cero tierras giradas, cero vidas pagadas por maná y una brecha de color de 0,0 puntos porcentuales en la auditoría, así que cada coste de {B}{B} es lanzable el turno que toca, que es lo que permite al mazo jugar ocho hechizos de eliminación junto a un motor de verdad. Intercambia uno a uno en curva mientras Braids Arisen Nightmare, Braids's Frightful Return, Gibbering Barricade y Bone Splinters convierten sus propios cuerpos gastados en cartas y combustible de cementerio. El cementerio paga entonces de tres formas: Sheoldred's Restoration devuelve el mejor cuerpo, el capítulo II de Braids's Frightful Return recupera uno a la mano, y el capítulo III de The Cruelty of Gix lee CUALQUIER cementerio, así que el paquete de eliminación que responde a las amenazas del rival está a la vez abasteciendo el cementerio del que roba Cruelty. Cult Conscript se devuelve solo por {1}{B} con esas mismas muertes. El reloj es Sheoldred, the Apocalypse y Tyrannical Pitlord; Blight Pile x2 es un drenaje SUPLEMENTARIO, no la condición de victoria: '{2}{B}, {T}: Each opponent loses X life, where X is the number of creatures with defender you control' es pérdida y no daño, así que es a prueba de bloqueadores e imprevenible, pero simulado sobre esta lista X promedia 1,0 en el turno 5 y 1,4 para el turno 8, no el 4 que daría un tablero lleno de Defensores.
